subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add structured progress metrics to existing plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns step totals, percentages, ETA, and terminal-state values?
rationale: The change is additive at the type level but creates public Plugin SDK semantics that live progress-card plugins may present as authoritative to users.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document absent unknowns, and test the affected producers.

options.title: Keep phase-only hooks
options.body: Leave plugins to derive textual or phase progress from current tool and lifecycle hooks until a stronger progress source exists.

options.title: Create a separate progress event
options.body: Design a dedicated progress event or agent-event projection instead of attaching percentages to tool and terminal hook payloads.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document absent unknowns, and test the affected producers.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal for hook contract shape and producer wiring points to vincentkoc.
